The air smelled putrid, and when I looked around… the sea was red. Deep red. Like, actual blood red.
I equipped my diving gear to investigate.
Below, I heard a deep rumble, followed by the very thing I was searching for.
It was searching for me, too.

At night, I can’t trust anything anymore. Not even my friend, who I’ve sailed with for years.
I saw through the illusion, but it sounded near perfect.
Now I’m getting paranoid. I’m too afraid to even help others anymore…
Doing so would risk my own life.

My shipmate woke last night, but something felt wrong. Maybe I was just drowsy, but that voice was… off.
I just didn’t trust it.
I ignored it and pretended to be asleep until I truly dozed off.
My mate does not recall being awake that night…

It was bones… human bones, drifting on the waves.
If this isn’t a sign to leave as fast as possible, I don’t know what is.
Still, I wonder whose remains they were… and how they ended up here.
